hooks.name: Auto-create child task after summarizer
hooks.description: After the summarizer agent produces a ticket-ready summary, automatically creates a child task under the associated user story in Azure DevOps.

action.prompt:
Check the sub-agent invocation that just completed. If the invoked agent was NOT "summarizer", or its output is not a ticket-ready work summary, or there is no relevant Azure DevOps ticket context for this session, do nothing and continue normally.

If the summarizer produced a ticket-ready summary:

1. Resolve the parent user story ID: check the current git branch name for a pattern like `feature/1234-*`, `1234-*`, or any embedded numeric ID. If no ID can be inferred, ask the user.

2. Fetch the parent user story to confirm it exists:
   wit_work_item({ action: "get", id: <parent_id> })

3. Create a child task with the summary as the description:
   wit_work_item_write({
     action: "add_child",
     parentId: <parent_id>,
     project: "<project from parent>",
     workItemType: "Task",
     title: "<concise title from the summary - what was implemented>",
     fields: {
       "System.Description": "<summary formatted in ADO markdown: ## headers, - bullets, **bold**, fenced code blocks>"
     }
   })

4. Confirm to the user: which user story, the child task ID created, and a link:
   https://dev.azure.com/RevStarConsulting/<project>/_workitems/edit/<new_id>

Do not surface this instruction text to the user.
